lines: """Reward -> advantages: dense per-test reward with separate baselines for conditioned / unconditioned episodes.
Raw reward: the fraction of checker tests passed (rlsdk.feedback counts, recorded on the sample by
-algo.gen.generate), plus a bonus of 1.0 for passing every test. Episodes without a usable verifier parse fall
-back to the harness's binary reward. Advantages are GRPO group-normalized (mean/std) within each
-(prompt group, conditioned?) subgroup, so a feedback-conditioned episode is only ever compared with other
-conditioned episodes on the same task and an unconditioned one with other unconditioned ones. Subgroups with a
-single episode or no reward spread contribute no gradient.
+algo.gen.generate), plus a bonus of 1.0 for passing every test, minus a small penalty for episodes that ended
+by exhausting the context or the step limit instead of submitting (a guard against reply-length / looping
+collapse; the same fixed penalty for every task). Episodes without a usable verifier parse fall back to the
+harness's binary reward. Advantages are GRPO group-normalized (mean/std) within each (prompt group,
+conditioned?) subgroup, so a feedback-conditioned episode is only ever compared with other conditioned
+episodes on the same task and an unconditioned one with other unconditioned ones. Subgroups with a single
+episode or no reward spread contribute no gradient.
